C0383.title: Multiple Ningbo Professional Store Closers Sentenced for Fraud in Prepaid Consumer Scam
C0383.summary: In February 2023, Qian, Li, and others took over a struggling photo studio in Haishu District, Ningbo. While the store lacked operating conditions, they used an anniversary prize campaign and false promises that recharge money would be returned after the event to induce consumers to pay, then fled overnight after the event and closed the store. The Yinzhou District People's Court held that Qian, Li, Zheng, and others had committed fraud and sentenced them to prison terms and fines; the Ningbo Intermediate People's Court later upheld the judgment on appeal.
